# Sydney Rental Heating Concern

A professional note that is polite, firm, and focused on resolution. It asks for a written repair timeline, temporary heating options, and keeps lease renewal in view without sounding threatening.

## Email Draft for Your Landlord

**Subject:** Request for Written Repair Timeline and Temporary Heating Support

Dear [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m writing about the heating in my 2-bedroom apartment, which has now failed three times in the past two months. The most recent repair was completed on 2026-04-18, but the issue appears to have returned again.

This has made the apartment uncomfortable and difficult to live in, especially during colder periods. I would appreciate a written timeline for the next repair, including when the technician will attend and what steps will be taken to prevent the problem from recurring.

In the meantime, please let me know whether temporary heating options can be provided while the system is being fixed. I would be grateful for a prompt response so we can resolve this as soon as possible.

I value the apartment and would like to continue my tenancy. If this matter is addressed properly, I would be pleased to consider renewing the lease.

Thank you for your attention to this issue. I look forward to your reply.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Apartment Address]
[Phone Number]

## Suggested Shorter Version

If you want a more concise version, use this:

Dear [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

I’m following up regarding the heating in my 2-bedroom apartment, which has failed three times in the past two months. The last repair was on 2026-04-18, but the issue has returned.

Please provide a written repair timeline, including when the next technician visit will occur and what will be done to prevent further failures. I would also appreciate temporary heating options while this is being resolved.

I value the apartment and would like to renew the lease if this issue is properly fixed. Thank you for your prompt attention.

Kind regards,
[Your Full Name]
